summary: Fun Train Games for Kids aged 2-7 - Safe and Easy Thomas & Friends™ Adventure
description:
Go on a magical train adventure with Thomas & Friends™ Magical Tracks
Fun, safe & interactive game play for children aged 2-7

Packed with interactive mini games, this customizable magical train set lets kids shape their own fun adventure.
Kids can ride the rails with favorite engines, and collect all the toys and decorations needed to create their very own Island of Sodor!

What magical adventures will you build today?

THE ULTIMATE TRAIN SET ADVENTURE
• EASY & SAFE train games for boys & girls
• PLAY with Thomas, Percy, Kana & more engines
• COLLECT track pieces
• BUILD train sets
• WIN toys and decorations
• RIDE freely and blow the whistle!

FUN MINI TRAIN GAMES
• RIDE the canyon rapids!
• BALANCE your engine as you race your way down Cannonball Curve!
• TRANSPORT various passengers and cargo
• HOSE down your engine to make it shine
• RACE against fellow engines!
• CLEAR the tracks of animals and debris
• OUTRUN the boulder in the Boulder Chase
• JUMP over the broken bridge

Play the free and fun train games app for preschool and kindergarten boys & girls aged 2,3,4,5,6,7!
